meta.name: verify
meta.description: Drive an engine app headlessly in a pty, record a video of the whole verification, and open a summary page (video + timeline + checks) with pixel open.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 驱动应用自动验证,录制全程视频并打开摘要页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要自动驱动应用运行并留下验证记录视频。
copy.tagline_en: Drive an app headlessly, record its verification, and open a summary page
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate app verification and capture a video record

howto.what: Claude 会为引擎应用写一个驱动脚本，在伪终端里无头运行它，边跑边录下每一帧、叠加点击波纹和说明字幕，编码成视频，并生成含时间线、检查表和截图的汇总页，最后用 pixel open 打开。
howto.when: 当你需要验证某个引擎应用的实际表现（如点击、滚动、键盘输入）时接管，走带录制的验证流程，而不是只导出 PNG 的一次性 pty 脚本。

say.text: 写个 verify 驱动脚本，验证滚轮滚动时光标不跑偏
say.note: 会录制全程并生成视频与检查表

say.text: 把这次验证的汇总页面打开
say.note: 用 pixel open 打开 summary.html

say.text: 加一条断言：滚动后画面发生了重绘
say.note: 断言结果会显示在汇总页的检查表中

howto.what_en: Claude writes a driver script to run an engine app headlessly in a pty, records every frame with input captions, encodes a video, and builds a summary page with timeline, checks and stills, then opens it with pixel open.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you need to verify how an engine app behaves on click, scroll or key input; it runs the recorder-based flow instead of one-off pty scripts that only dump PNGs.
